sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes CP applicability, ship ownership, explicit branch-selection evidence, required pitch quantities, metre units, and the 0.7 free-running-pitch derivation using tolerance scaled from the expected result.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent existential cherry-picking and ambiguous branch selection. For each CP ship, require exactly one pitchValueKnown value and constrain every such value to xsd:boolean; the current FILTER NOT EXISTS passes when one valid boolean exists alongside invalid or contradictory values. Require exactly one applicable bollard quantity and, in the false branch, exactly one free-running quantity, with each quantity having exactly one xsd:decimal qudt:numericValue and unit:M.
